name: @pipeworx/mcp-chargebee

tools.name: chargebee_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List all subscriptions with optional filtering by status (e.g., 'active', 'cancelled'). Returns subscription IDs, plans, amounts, and renewal dates. Paginate with limit and offset.

status.description: Filter by subscription status: active, cancelled, non_renewing, future, in_trial, paused

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100)

offset.description: Pagination offset from a previous response

tools.name: chargebee_get_subscription
tools.description: Get full subscription details by ID. Returns plan, status, billing dates, customer info, and all charges.

tools.name: chargebee_list_customers
tools.description: List all customers with pagination. Returns customer IDs, names, emails, billing addresses, and creation dates.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100)

offset.description: Pagination offset from a previous response

tools.name: chargebee_get_customer
tools.description: Get complete customer profile by ID. Returns name, email, address, payment methods, subscription count, and account status.

tools.name: chargebee_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices filtered by status (e.g., 'paid', 'pending') and/or customer ID. Returns invoice numbers, amounts, dates, and payment status. Paginate with limit and offset.

status.description: Filter by invoice status: paid, posted, payment_due, not_paid, voided, pending

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100)

offset.description: Pagination offset from a previous response

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-chargebee forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the chargebee pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
